function.name: date_current_date
function.description: Returns the current local date without time information. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

format.description: The desired string format for the returned date. For example, 'YYYY-MM-DD' for a date like '2023-04-05'.

locale.description: The locale to use for returning the date, influencing the language of month names and day names.

message.content: I’m sorry—I don’t have access to your device’s real‑time clock, so I can’t tell you the precise current time right now. If you let me know which city or time zone you’re interested in (or simply check the clock on your computer/phone), I’ll gladly help interpret or convert times for you!

So we cannot get exact time. Could respond with approximate or say can't determine due to lack of timezone context. Probably best answer: I don't know current time because I'm offline. Or ask user location/timezone.
